course_name_original: Introdução aos Sistemas de Energia Eléctrica

learning_outcomes.text: Students should master the basic concepts necessary to understand the operation of electrical energy systems, including the main characteristics of energy production, transmission and distribution systems.
Students should understand the importance of studies of power transits.
Students should understand the formation of electricity costs and the need and utility of tariff systems as a useful tool for disciplining the use of electricity.
Students should master the basics of power management and power factor compensation.

syllabus_topics: Characterization of electricity generation and consumption
Main organizational and operational characteristics of power systems
bibliography: José Pedro Sucena Paiva (2011) – Redes de Energia Elétrica: Uma Análise Sistemática, IST Press, 3ª Edição.

degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
